sample_reviews: ⭐ Very disappointing experience with CRED’s referral program. I completed the referral requirements, but the promised reward was not credited. Customer support was also unable to provide a clear solution. If you offer referral rewards, you should honor them. Extremely frustrating experience. Definitely not recommended.

CRED has completely lost the customer-friendly features that made it great. The app used to offer real cashback and excellent rewards for paying bills on time. Now, it just gives you "CRED Coins" which are completely useless and have zero real-world value. Instead of a rewarding experience, the app is now heavily cluttered with aggressive ads pushing loans, rent payments, and credit lines
